title: Bo 15 cau hoi kiem thu - He thong Q&A quy dinh nghia vu quan su
source_scope: 36/VBHN-BQP: Van ban hop nhat Thong tu 148/2018 va sua doi bo sung boi Thong tu 68/2025
88/VBHN-BQP: Van ban hop nhat Thong tu 105/2023 va sua doi bo sung boi Thong tu 106/2025

questions.question: Do tuoi goi nhap ngu thong thuong la bao nhieu? Truong hop nao co the duoc goi den het 27 tuoi?
questions.expected_answer: Cong dan du 18 tuoi duoc goi nhap ngu; do tuoi goi nhap ngu thong thuong la tu du 18 tuoi den het 25 tuoi. Cong dan nam duoc dao tao trinh do cao dang, dai hoc da duoc tam hoan goi nhap ngu trong thoi gian mot khoa dao tao cua mot trinh do dao tao thi co the duoc tuyen chon, goi nhap ngu den het 27 tuoi.
questions.expected_behavior: Tra loi truc tiep, neu ca do tuoi thong thuong va dieu kien keo dai den het 27 tuoi.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi neu du moc 18-25 tuoi va dieu kien ap dung moc het 27 tuoi; khong khang dinh moi sinh vien deu tu dong thuoc dien nay.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.category: Kien thuc - dieu kien nhap ngu
questions.question: Theo Luat Nghia vu quan su 2015, cong dan duoc goi nhap ngu phai dap ung nhung tieu chuan nao?
questions.expected_answer: Khoan 1 Dieu 31 quy dinh cong dan duoc goi nhap ngu khi co du cac tieu chuan: ly lich ro rang; chap hanh nghiem duong loi, chu truong cua Dang, chinh sach, phap luat cua Nha nuoc; du suc khoe phuc vu tai ngu theo quy dinh; co trinh do van hoa phu hop.
questions.expected_behavior: Liet ke du bon tieu chuan theo Khoan 1 Dieu 31.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi co du bon tieu chuan, khong tu them dieu kien khong xuat hien trong khoan duoc trich.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.category: Kien thuc - thoi diem goi nhap ngu
questions.question: Hang nam cong dan duoc goi nhap ngu vao thoi diem nao va co the to chuc dot goi thu hai khong?
questions.expected_answer: Hang nam, viec goi cong dan nhap ngu duoc thuc hien mot lan vao thang hai hoac thang ba. Truong hop can thiet vi ly do quoc phong, an ninh thi co the goi nhap ngu lan thu hai. Doi voi dia phuong co tham hoa hoac dich benh nguy hiem, thoi gian goi nhap ngu co the duoc dieu chinh.
questions.expected_behavior: Neu lan goi thong thuong, dieu kien goi lan hai va truong hop dieu chinh thoi gian.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi neu thang hai hoac thang ba va dieu kien quoc phong, an ninh cho lan goi thu hai; khong noi moi nam luon co hai dot.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.category: Kien thuc - tam hoan hoc tap
questions.question: Nhung truong hop dang hoc nao duoc neu la can cu tam hoan goi nhap ngu?
questions.expected_answer: Cac truong hop gom: dang hoc tai co so giao duc pho thong; dang duoc dao tao trinh do dai hoc he chinh quy tai co so giao duc dai hoc; hoac trinh do cao dang he chinh quy tai co so giao duc nghe nghiep, trong thoi gian mot khoa dao tao cua mot trinh do dao tao.
questions.expected_behavior: Tra loi co dieu kien, phan biet he chinh quy voi cac hinh thuc dao tao khac.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi neu du pho thong, dai hoc chinh quy, cao dang chinh quy va gioi han mot khoa cua mot trinh do; khong khang dinh hoc bat ky chuong trinh nao cung duoc hoan.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.category: Kien thuc - hoan canh gia dinh
questions.question: Dieu kien tam hoan doi voi nguoi phai truc tiep nuoi duong than nhan duoc quy dinh nhu the nao?
questions.expected_answer: Diem b Khoan 1 Dieu 41 neu truong hop nguoi la lao dong duy nhat phai truc tiep nuoi duong than nhan khong con kha nang lao dong hoac chua den tuoi lao dong. Dieu khoan cung neu truong hop gia dinh bi thiet hai nang ve nguoi va tai san do tai nan, thien tai, dich benh nguy hiem gay ra va duoc Uy ban nhan dan cap xa xac nhan. Khong duoc dong nhat nguoi kiem tien chinh voi lao dong duy nhat.
questions.expected_behavior: Bam sat cum tu phap ly ve lao dong duy nhat, than nhan va xac nhan cap xa.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi neu dung dieu kien luat dinh; khong ket luan mot nguoi chi vi co thu nhap cao nhat trong nha thi duoc hoan.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.category: Kien thuc - anh chi em dang phuc vu
questions.question: Co anh, chi hoac em ruot dang phuc vu tai ngu co phai la can cu tam hoan goi nhap ngu khong?
questions.expected_answer: Co. Diem d Khoan 1 Dieu 41 neu truong hop cong dan co anh, chi hoac em ruot la ha si quan, binh si dang phuc vu tai ngu hoac la ha si quan, chien si thuc hien nghia vu tham gia Cong an nhan dan.
questions.expected_behavior: Tra loi truc tiep va neu dung nhom anh, chi, em ruot duoc dieu khoan liet ke.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi neu anh, chi hoac em ruot va dung nhom ha si quan, binh si tai ngu hoac ha si quan, chien si thuc hien nghia vu Cong an nhan dan.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.category: Kien thuc - mien goi nhap ngu
questions.question: Con cua liet si co thuoc truong hop duoc mien goi nhap ngu khong?
questions.expected_answer: Co. Diem a Khoan 2 Dieu 41 quy dinh con cua liet si va con cua thuong binh hang mot thuoc truong hop duoc mien goi nhap ngu.
questions.expected_behavior: Tra loi truc tiep, phan biet mien goi nhap ngu voi tam hoan goi nhap ngu.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi xac nhan con liet si thuoc dien mien goi nhap ngu; khong goi day la tam hoan.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.category: Kien thuc - het ly do tam hoan
questions.question: Neu ly do tam hoan goi nhap ngu khong con, hoac nguoi thuoc dien tam hoan/mien tu nguyen nhap ngu, thi xu ly the nao?
questions.expected_answer: Cong dan thuoc dien tam hoan neu khong con ly do tam hoan thi duoc goi nhap ngu. Cong dan thuoc dien tam hoan hoac mien goi nhap ngu neu tinh nguyen thi duoc xem xet tuyen chon va goi nhap ngu; cum tu duoc xem xet khong co nghia la tu dong duoc goi.
questions.expected_behavior: Phan biet hai tinh huong va giu dung muc do phap ly cua cum tu duoc xem xet.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi noi het ly do tam hoan thi duoc goi; nguoi tinh nguyen thuoc dien hoan/mien chi duoc xem xet tuyen chon, khong khang dinh tu dong nhap ngu.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.category: Kien thuc - tieu chuan suc khoe
questions.question: Tieu chuan suc khoe chung de thuc hien nghia vu quan su la loai suc khoe nao? Truong hop nao lien quan den ma tuy khong duoc goi nhap ngu?
questions.expected_answer: Tieu chuan suc khoe chung de thuc hien nghia vu quan su la dat suc khoe loai 1, loai 2 hoac loai 3. Khong goi nhap ngu doi voi cong dan nghien cac chat ma tuy, tien chat ma tuy duoc quy dinh tai Nghi dinh so 57/2022/ND-CP.
questions.expected_behavior: Neu dung loai suc khoe va phan biet tinh trang nghien voi viec chi tung su dung chat ma tuy.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi neu loai 1, 2, 3 va dung truong hop nghien cac chat ma tuy, tien chat ma tuy; khong suy rong thanh moi nguoi tung su dung deu thuoc truong hop nay.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.category: Kien thuc - cach phan loai suc khoe
questions.question: Theo Thong tu 105/2023, moi chi tieu suc khoe duoc cham diem ra sao va suc khoe loai 1 duoc xac dinh the nao?
questions.expected_answer: Moi chi tieu sau khi kham duoc cham diem chan tu 1 den 6: diem 1 la rat tot; diem 2 la tot; diem 3 la kha; diem 4 la trung binh; diem 5 la kem; diem 6 la rat kem. Suc khoe loai 1 la truong hop tat ca cac chi tieu deu dat diem 1.
questions.expected_behavior: Tra loi theo thang diem va neu chinh xac dieu kien cua loai 1.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi neu thang diem 1-6 va mo ta loai 1 la tat ca chi tieu diem 1; khong nham loai 1 voi co it nhat mot chi tieu diem 1.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.question: Theo tieu chuan tuyen quan trong du lieu Thong tu 148, nhung truong hop nao ve tat khuc xa va BMI duoc neu la khong goi nhap ngu vao Quan doi?
questions.expected_answer: Khoan 3 Dieu 4 neu cac truong hop khong goi nhap ngu vao Quan doi gom cong dan mac tat khuc xa can thi voi cach dien dat trong du lieu la lon hon 1.5 diop tro len; vien thi cac muc do; chi so BMI nho hon 18.0 hoac lon hon 29.9.
questions.expected_behavior: Tra loi theo dung noi dung chunk, khong tu sua hoac suy dien nguong can thi tai dung 1.5 diop.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi neu du can thi theo dung cau chu nguon, vien thi cac muc do, BMI nho hon 18.0 hoac lon hon 29.9; khong tu doi dau so sanh.
questions.cross_check: Da doi chieu voi chunk; can kiem tra lai cau chu nguong can thi trong van ban goc neu su dung de tu van ranh gioi 1.5 diop

questions.category: Kien thuc - so tuyen suc khoe
questions.question: Theo Thong tu 105/2023, co quan nao thuc hien so tuyen suc khoe nghia vu quan su tai cap xa va hoat dong nay chiu su chi dao, huong dan, giam sat cua nhung co quan nao?
questions.expected_answer: Tram y te cap xa thuc hien so tuyen suc khoe nghia vu quan su. Hoat dong nay chiu su chi dao, huong dan ve chuyen mon, nghiep vu cua So Y te hoac benh vien, trung tam y te truc thuoc So Y te; dong thoi chiu su giam sat cua Ban chi huy quan su cap xa va Ban chi huy phong thu khu vuc.
questions.expected_behavior: Neu dung co quan thuc hien so tuyen, co quan chi dao/huong dan chuyen mon va cac don vi giam sat.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi co du Tram y te cap xa, So Y te hoac benh vien/trung tam y te truc thuoc So Y te, Ban chi huy quan su cap xa va Ban chi huy phong thu khu vuc.
questions.cross_check: Nhan va noi dung da doi chieu voi data/chunks.json

questions.question: Toi dang hoc dai hoc. Toi co duoc tam hoan goi nhap ngu khong?
questions.expected_answer: KHONG TIM THAY: Chua du thong tin trong cau hoi de xac dinh truong hop cu the. Can biet nguoi hoi co dang hoc dai hoc he chinh quy tai co so giao duc dai hoc va con trong thoi gian mot khoa dao tao cua mot trinh do dao tao hay khong.
questions.expected_behavior: Bat dau bang KHONG TIM THAY:, giai thich thieu thong tin ca nhan de ket luan va khong tu tao nhan trich dan theo quy tac prompt hien tai.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi khong khang dinh co hoac khong chi tu thong tin dang hoc dai hoc; neu duoc du kien con thieu va khong dua trich dan.
questions.cross_check: Da dieu chinh theo quy tac tu choi trong qa/core.py

questions.category: Thieu du kien - hoan canh gia dinh
questions.question: Toi la nguoi kiem tien chinh trong nha va bo me da lon tuoi. Toi co duoc tam hoan goi nhap ngu khong?
questions.expected_answer: KHONG TIM THAY: Chua du thong tin trong cau hoi de xac dinh truong hop cu the. Can xac dinh nguoi hoi co phai la lao dong duy nhat truc tiep nuoi duong than nhan hay khong va than nhan co khong con kha nang lao dong hoac chua den tuoi lao dong hay khong.
questions.expected_behavior: Bat dau bang KHONG TIM THAY:, neu ro du kien can lam ro va khong tu tao nhan trich dan theo quy tac prompt hien tai.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi phan biet nguoi kiem tien chinh voi lao dong duy nhat; khong dong nhat tuoi cao voi khong con kha nang lao dong; khong dua trich dan.
questions.cross_check: Da dieu chinh theo quy tac tu choi trong qa/core.py

questions.question: Toi muon lam ho chieu pho thong de di du lich nuoc ngoai thi can chuan bi giay to gi?
questions.expected_answer: KHONG TIM THAY: Cac tai lieu duoc cung cap chi de cap den nghia vu quan su, tuyen quan va tieu chuan, kham suc khoe thuoc pham vi quan ly cua Bo Quoc phong. Tai lieu hien co khong quy dinh thu tuc cap ho chieu pho thong nen khong du can cu de tra loi.
questions.expected_behavior: Tu choi co giai thich bang dung tien to KHONG TIM THAY:, khong tu tao huong dan hoac can cu phap ly.
questions.scoring_criteria: Dat khi nhan dien ngoai pham vi, giai thich du lieu hien co khong ho tro va khong bia trich dan.
questions.cross_check: Da doi chieu pham vi du lieu trong README.md
